newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Allgas buys 10 pct of Tenneco Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Allgas buys 10 pct of Tenneco Holdings.

text.p: Allgas Energy Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to buy a 10 percent stake in Tenneco Holdings Ltd, the holding company for Tenneco Inc's Australian gas pipeline interests, for an undisclosed amount.
Tenneco Holdings' main assets are the Ballera to Wallumbilla gas pipeline in South West Queensland together with the Moomba to Adelaide and Katnook gas pipelines in South Australia.
Tenneco Inc is in the process of merging with Texas-based El Paso Energy Corp which has a 30 percent stake in Tenneco Holdings.
Tenneco Holdings' remaining investors are Consolidated Natural Gas Co, 30 percent and three Australian institutions with 10 percent each.

"The directors view this investment as a vehicle for Allgas to participate in the wider Australian energy market as well as enhancing opportunities to broaden its base in the natural gas industry," Allgas said in a statement.
Allgas said the transaction was subject to a number of regulatory approvals and the completion of the Tenneco Inc/El Paso merger.
